notes.title: Update: Running Speed Improved
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've been busy is the last couple of day in Gamers' Con. We were showcasing the game there and got a lot of feedback.

One feedback was to increase the default running speed. So we did just that!

We also noticed some problems in the localized version of the game that cause gameplay problems. That was also fixed.

Also, in some unfortunate events, some players slip of the level and fall into oblivion. In the even such thing happen, we made sure players will respawn in a proper location this time.

Thank you for supporting this game!

notes.title: Introducing Monster Dash! The new way to catch humans! Version 2.8 Alpha
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/c937467a4070e70f3cabbbc6872703e3c254b78c.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, we are proud to announce our latest update 2.8 Alpha.

Introducing the Monster Dash!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/e75f27c647c5ef96403af62562dbb4ae49d7c93a.gif[/img]

This is a feature that has been requested multiple times. In older versions, monsters catch humans by just getting close enough to them. However, now we changed it so that monsters need to Dash in order for them to be able to catch the humans. When you dash, you can only move forward, so there is a chance that you will miss the human. If you miss the human, you will have a penalty on your movement speed for few seconds before you can run at full speed and dash again. Dashing happens by pressing (X or ▢ or Q) buttons.


We also improved the UI. Abilities, powers and dash will pop and have a sound once they are ready to use again. This is specially useful when you are absorbed in locating another human or running away from a monster. It is always good to know when your tools are ready to use!

Here is a video showcasing those features:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zAvvqVyj-7U

notes.title: The latest update to our latest game mode (Monster Transformation). Version 2.7 Alpha Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/0d72e0b1f9946ee0560705217e177ccbe6851cb7.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, we are proud to announce our latest update to our latest game mode (Monster Transformation). We added a time limit for the match. A match used to take 12 min+. Now there is a 5 minutes limit. In order to win, the humans need to meet for 15 seconds. When the time is up, the game goes to overtime. In overtime, the game ends when humans meet for 2 seconds only.

Also, when humans meet now, multiple meetup orange waves will start shooting, indicating the location of the meetup. You will also see the countdown of the meetup in the game’s log. The meetup waves will help the monsters locate the humans for a chance to catch either of them before the 15 seconds run out.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3677/3676053/profile/MEETUP_WAVE_optomized.gif[/img]

We also improved the human AI. Now the human AI will recognize the other human footstep sound and will try to reach the other human even if there are walls between them.

For better gameplay, we increased the human meetup range from a radius of 2 to 4 meters. This will help in improving the play experience specially when playing online.

Lastly, we did some changes to the UI for things to be clearer. We increased the game log size and flipped the item and skill UI and added the timer.

Here is a new video showcasing the gameplay:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=20FOEJmhJ5I

notes.title: New Game Mode: Monster Transformation! Version 2.6.7.9 Alpha Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/c70edbe696117996013246ed0c47d80d355c3c3f.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! We are happy to introduce our latest addition to the game, Monster Transformation Mode! 

In this mode, that game can only end if both humans meet for 15 seconds. And if a monster catches a human

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XJPp0oQNrmw

A new game mode (Monster Transformation):In this mode, the game ends only when the humans stay close to each other for 15 seconds.  So, when you play as monster and you catch a human, you will become a human, and he will become a monster. Now, as a new human, you have to find the other human to win.

Here is the list of changes in this version:
[list]
[*] The game now has 2 game modes and you can play them both:
Fast Catch: the original game mode.
Monster Transformation: the new game mode.
[*] Added a new human voice (Amazing voice acting by Jeremy Frutkin)
[*] Redesigned the game log (the one on the top right corner) to show a better display of the powers used and important game events.
[*] Invisibility now allows you to pass through monsters without being caught.
[*] Speed boost effect was increased.
[*] Added confirmation popup on game quit and room leaving
[*] Improved the AI (it can’t detect you if it can’t see you or hear you).
[*] Improved the shout wave design.
[*] Improved the power and ability oval indicator with colors.
[*] Added an on-screen sound mute indicator (like TVs).
[*] Players now are able to select team by clicking on the monster or human as a button.
[*] Overall UI improvements.
[*] Fixed several issues with powers usage.
[*] Fixed an issue where duplicate names might appear in the waiting area.
[*] Fixed several UI issues.
[*] Fixed an issue with wrong footsteps sound being played.
[*] Fixed an issue where a newly connected gamepad does not work properly.
[*] Fixed a gate issue in Hesen 2 level.
[*] Fixed an issue when the monster sound returns, it’s plays very loud for half a second.
[*] Fixed an issue where even if you had Steam overlay you could control the game.
[*] Removed color banding from the camera. Removed precomputed GI.
[/list]

We look forward to our next update! 

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Introducing Power Ups! Version 2.4.3.2 Alpha Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/438df972d17dc1bf3bcfcc74b7196734a3cac2db.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! We are happy to introduce our latest addition to the game, POWER UPS!

You will get a power up after each 10 seconds. You will be assigned randomly one of the following:
[list]
[*] Invisibility: Cross to the other dimension. You’re invisible, they can’t see you!
[*] Fireworks: Light it up and increase your vision area.
[*] Blind: Let’s you overpower the other team by making it pitch dark for them.
[*] Sprint: Makes you faster than The Flash himself. Run, player! RUN!
[*] Slow: Makes the other team slower than snails. Can you win against snails?
[/list]

Here is a video showcasing the gameplay with items: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xDlMhfpD_xI

In addition to that, we Greatly Improved monsters AI. Before, the monsters can only hear the shouts. But now they can hear your footsteps as well.

Humans can now Crouch. Crouching will make your movement soundless but halves your movement speed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/a68bd85bb126c4b669867899d0d10e0f3ee3c0e1.jpg[/img]

We fixed some errors in the Tutorial levels that includes not being able to finish them. 

We also increased the texture qualities in the game. They look better now.

We improved the lights in the game. They now have a realistic feeling to them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/2f3d09c23a0ee8034aedd0b9070336125082e3fb.gif[/img]

Now monsters will leap on the humans to catch them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/535c68af0469ab601637b8f3b1710e5068180b79.gif[/img]

Also we added some cool sky effects!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/5f04442822389d306076a7ae85513b84454d9196.jpg[/img]

And lastly, we improved the spawning system. Before, the spawning system never cared about rotating the players. So some players might start with their face on the wall or facing a really weird direction. 

We look forward to our next update!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Changes since the demo
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25725792/01edf2f001db07df05a63b4b5200c94419203b07.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are pleased to to announce a shortened list of the differences between the demo version we released on GameJolt and this Early Access version on Steam. We are still working on adding and improving things in our game. We look forward to do that with the help of your continuous feedback.

Here is the list:

New features:
[list]
[*] Created 7 new levels.
[*] Created 2 new levels themes.
[*] Added character customization.
[*] Fully redesigned the user interface.
[*] Added Leaderboard.
[*] Added Steam API Integration for Inviting friends.
[*] Added Localization for both English and Arabic.
[*] Added ambient music to gameplay only. The intensity of the music will change depending on the situation.
[*] Added Rumble to gamepads.
[*] Added voice chat inside the game and inside the waiting area.
[*] Added a countdown for the game to start.
[*] Added player status before the game starts. (Joining/Ready)
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved AI.
[*] Improved levels visuals.
[*] Improved design of older levels.
[*] Fixed bugs in tutorials, UI and gameplay.
[/list]
